chainIdSource: require(block.chainid == CHAIN_ID) in the overridden run(); CHAIN_ID = 1 inherited from DeployMainnetPromotionReady
intentComment: READ-ONLY POST-BROADCAST VERIFICATION (story 075, script-audit run-22 M-01). No --broadcast, no --ledger, nothing signed, nothing written. Runs as a SEPARATE forge script invocation AFTER the cutover has settled, which is the entire point: forge script executes the whole cutover body once LOCALLY and dispatches the ~60 transactions afterwards, so Phase 0, every in-phase post-condition and all of _phase7_wiringAssertions() had already evaluated against PRE-broadcast state before transaction #1 left the machine, and --skip-simulation removes the pre-send sanity check rather than that local pass. Phase 8's BLOCKING probes are gated off under broadcast. This leg re-runs Phase 7's ABSOLUTE wiring assertions against LIVE chain state, plus the phUSD mint-authority check that existed on no path before story 075. It CONSUMES the write-once baselines.bptAtCutover persisted by story 074 and NEVER re-derives it. Every check is a require, so any failure exits non-zero and halts the '&&' chain. Safe to re-run at will. NOT DISCHARGED HERE and still a human step: story-072 checklist line 1197 (trigger one index-4 mint, assert BatchDonatedViaPSM fired). STORY 076 RESTATED ITS MINT-AUTHORITY CLAIM from INVARIANCE to an EXPECTED TWO-SIDED DELTA plus a POSITIVE assertion that PhlimboV3 holds mint authority, and added a SECOND consumed baseline, phlimboV2StakedAtCutover.

forgeTarget.inheritanceNote: INHERIT, DON'T COPY (story 075). Deriving from the deploy script gives the verifier all ~40 address constants, the 16 runtime address members, _loadProgressFile(), _phase7_wiringAssertions() and its _assertSlot/_assertHookPair/_assertStream helpers for free. Chosen over --sig, which would have left a live callable run() that performs the entire cutover. CARRIED-FORWARD NIT from story 075: it still inherits the whole cutover body including its vm.startBroadcast blocks; only run() is overridden.

offChainWrites: NONE. This key writes no file of any kind.
executionBody: _requireNoBroadcastFlag()  -- rejects PREVIEW_MODE, which means nothing on a live read-only pass. There is no cheatcode that reports --broadcast, so the real control is structural: this contract opens no broadcast context anywhere, pinned at SOURCE level by test/VerifyPromotionReadyGuards.t.sol scanning the file text.

_loadAndValidateProgressFile()  -- requires the progress file to exist and resolves ALL 16 RUNTIME ADDRESSES (14 at story 075; story 076 added PhlimboV3 and MigratorV2V3); requires _isDeployed('NudgeStreamer') && _isDeployed('BatchNFTMinter')

_adoptPersistedBptBaseline()  -- ABORTS if baselines.bptAtCutover is absent or zero. NO live-read fallback, deliberately: post-broadcast the old pooler is always empty, so a live read yields 0 and the BPT conservation assertion collapses to balanceOf(newPooler) >= 0. The audit is explicit that a standalone verifier without the persisted baseline ACTIVELY WORSENS finding L-02 (pps22l2) from Low to Medium.

_adoptPersistedPhlimboBaseline()  [STORY 076]  -- same crux applied to the PhlimboV2 -> PhlimboV3 stake migration. ABORTS if baselines.phlimboV2StakedAtCutover is absent or zero; post-broadcast PhlimboV2 is ALWAYS empty by construction (the cutover's own completeness gate requires totalStaked() == 0), so a re-derived baseline is 0 and the assertion collapses to phlimboV3.totalStaked() >= 0.
_phase7_wiringAssertions()  -- the whole point: re-run against LIVE post-broadcast state

mintAuthorityClaims.1_expectedTwoSidedDelta: liveMask == (phusdMinterMaskAtPhase0 & ~(1 << PHUSD_MINTER_BIT_PHLIMBO_V2)) over the fixed 20-address candidate set, PLUS liveVersion == phusdMintVersionAtPhase0. Story 075's claim was INVARIANCE (byte-identical membership) because story 072 made zero phUSD.setMinter calls; Phase 4e makes two, so invariance is now the WRONG claim and would fail on a correct cutover. Asserting both directions is what keeps the control meaningful: a one-sided 'V2 was revoked' check would not notice an unintended grant or revoke elsewhere in the set. phUSD's global mintVersion is still asserted UNCHANGED - setMinter does not touch it, only revokeAllMintPrivileges does, and the cutover never calls that. Guarded by _requirePhlimboV2BitIndex() so a reordered candidate array cannot silently repoint the bit while still passing.
mintAuthorityClaims.2_positiveForPhlimboV3: canMint && grantedAt == liveVersion for newPhlimboV3. It is a runtime CREATE so it cannot live in the pure compile-time candidate set and its grant cannot be expressed as a mask bit. It MUST be asserted somewhere because a missing grant fails SILENTLY: PhlimboV3._claimRewards banks a failed mint rather than reverting (PhlimboV3.sol:913 - VERIFIED at pin f279c62).
mintAuthorityClaims.3_absoluteSweep: _requireNotPhusdMinter over the OTHER 15 newly deployed contracts - none may hold phUSD mint authority. PhlimboV3 is the ONE declared exclusion; MigratorV2V3 STAYS IN the sweep (V2 itself mints the pending phUSD rewards during withdraw, so the migrator needs no role). A blanket relaxation to accommodate PhlimboV3 would silently discard a real control.
mintAuthorityClaims.noteBranch: If the baseline's bit 19 was never set, the verifier LOGS a NOTE rather than letting a green run imply a revoke was verified. Story 076 Autonomous Decision 1 records that on mainnet the Phase 0 mask reads 270080 with bit 19 CLEAR - i.e. PhlimboV2 does NOT currently hold phUSD mint authority and step 14's revoke is a NO-OP today.

sourceLevelGuards.test/VerifyPromotionReadyGuards.t.sol: Asserts source-level properties of script/VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol that no behavioural model can reach - chiefly that it contains NO balanceOf(OLD_POOLER) live-read fallback for the BPT cutover baseline, and no state-mutating cheatcodes. foundry.toml grants read on ./script purely to enable this (a carried-forward [low] from story 075). Because of this scan, the forbidden literals are deliberately never spelled out verbatim anywhere in VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol.
sourceLevelGuards.test/PhusdMinterDeltaGuards.t.sol: Story 076 Autonomous Decision 6, not requested by the checklist. A 9-test no-fork suite proving the shipped two-sided check rejects a stray grant elsewhere, a stray revoke elsewhere, and a V2 revoke that never landed - including a test showing the NAIVE one-sided check passing what the shipped one rejects.
